title: Death Has a Shadow
summary: After drinking too much at a stag party and falling asleep at work, Peter loses his job, signs up for welfare, and gets more money than expected.

reviews.review: The pilot that started it all. Raw energy, unhinged early cutaways, and the beginning of a 400+ episode journey.
reviews.pullQuote: We cranked our hogs pretty hard.

reviews.review: Watched the original 1999 broadcast after the Super Bowl at age eight and loved it immediately. Pure nostalgia.
Didn't see it until middle school, but the rhythm of the jokes holds up better than I expected.

title: I Never Met the Dead Man
summary: Peter goes into shock after he disables the entire Quahog cable system while giving Meg driving lessons; Stewie plots to rid the world of broccoli.

reviews.review: Peter walking around with a cardboard TV cutout frame is peak season one idiocy.
The TV withdrawal bits and Tom Tucker's broadcast are fantastic.
reviews.pullQuote: 80 out of 100 Quahogs after the math recalculation.

reviews.review: The Amish driving-test gag and character bits are great.
reviews.pullQuote: Four out of five from me.

title: Chitty Chitty Death Bang
summary: Peter tries to make the best of a bad situation after he ruins Lois's plans for Stewie's birthday party; Meg's new friend tries to recruit her into a cult.

reviews.review: Dark cult storyline and bizarre early joke logic, but Stewie meeting the man in white is iconic.
reviews.pullQuote: A weird detour with high death tolls.

reviews.review: Defending the Cheesecake Factory and Cheesy Charlie's chaos.
Loose logic and early character friction, but fun to break down.

title: Mind Over Murder
summary: Peter gets put under house arrest and builds a basement bar.

reviews.review: Ye Olde Pube in the basement and Hot Lois piano superstar status.
A divisive one for the boys, but the Mentos cold open is unforgettable.
The time machine subplot and Quahog neighborhood dynamics make this a fun watch.

title: A Hero Sits Next Door
summary: Peter becomes jealous of his new neighbor Joe Swanson after Joe saves the day and becomes the town hero.

reviews.review: Introducing Joe Swanson and Patrick Warburton to the universe was a monumental moment.
The softball game, the bank robbery, and the Grinch voice bit all hit.
Christian Hughes guest appearance and great banter all around.
reviews.pullQuote: One of the best early season one episodes.

title: The Son Also Draws
summary: Peter and the family head to a Native American casino in New York after Chris gets kicked out of the Youth Scouts.

reviews.review: Peter's vision quest and the vanishing blender continuity error are classic discussion points.
Early cutaways hold up nicely even if the road trip logic is wacky.
The sign joke and Lois discovering gambling make for a solid episode recap.
